summary: Focused retest of the GT (Logistics) + Return Fee masters bug fix. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_gt_return_masters.py (11 tests, 11 passed). GET /api/masters/gt-charges returns exactly 96 rows, every row has non-empty sub_category/level/price_range/price_lower/price_upper and charge>0, no _id leakage; GET /api/masters/return-fees returns exactly 12 unique (level,zone) rows all with fee>0. Both endpoints correctly reject unauthenticated calls (401 'Not authenticated'). Other masters regression: commission-rules=155, fixed-fees=272 (previous 200-row cap is FIXED), subcat-levels=16, tolerance/tax-rates/settlement-settings singletons all return expected keys. No 'kazo' string in any master API payload. latin_masters_seed.json on disk holds commission_rules=155, fixed_fees=272, subcat_levels=16, gt_charges=96, return_fees=12 so a fresh DB bootstraps identically. Frontend: logged in as admin@fundle.ai/admin123 -> Overview OK, /masters loads; GT (LOGISTICS) tab header reads 'GT / Logistics Charges (incl. GST) · 96 entries' with 96 rendered rows and 0 rows having empty/zero values; RETURN FEE tab reads 'Return Fee Matrix · 12 entries' with 12 rows (Level 1-4 x Local/Zonal/National, fees 125.08-390.58) all non-zero. Commission Rules 155 rows, Fixed Fee 272 rows, Sub-Cat Levels 16 rows, Tolerance/Settlement/Tax panels render. ZERO console errors; 'kazo/KAZO' absent from rendered DOM on both the Login page and the Masters page. Primary bug fix VERIFIED.

issues: Derived GT charges are non-monotonic across price bands within the same sub-category/level (e.g. Blazers L3: 0-250=53.10, 450-700=53.10, but 700-1050=31.86, 1050-1800=55.46; Coats L4: 450-700=71.98 then 700-1050=18.88). Logistics charge normally rises with price band, so these medians look like sparse-sample artifacts. Data-quality note only, not a blocker.
Return Fee matrix covers Level 1-4 only (12 rows as specified) - no Level 5 row, so any Level-5 sub-category return will fall back/unmap.

action_items: None blocking for this fix. Optional: smooth/monotonic-check the derived GT charge bands and consider deriving a Level 5 return-fee row for completeness.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_latin_masters() seeds per-collection only when that collection is empty - correct/idempotent, but if a partial load leaves one collection with a few rows the seed silently skips it; consider logging the skip decision per collection.

Leftover legacy seed constants in masters.py (RETURN_FEE_SEED / GT_LEVEL_SEED / SUBCAT_LEVEL_SEED with 'KAZO' docstrings) are still reachable via POST /api/masters/reset-defaults -> seed_defaults(), which would wipe the Latin Quarter masters and replace them with the old KAZO matrices. Point reset-defaults at seed_latin_masters or remove the endpoint.
Frontend still stores auth under localStorage keys kazo_token / kazo_user (lib/api.js, context/AuthContext.jsx) - not user visible, carried over from iteration_1.
seed_data_creation: None - read-only verification, no data written.
test_credentials: admin@fundle.ai / admin123 (admin) - verified working via API and UI

rca_of_the_issue: Original defect: LQ's uploaded masters workbook had no GT charge amounts or return-fee matrix, so gt_charges/return_fees stayed empty and both Masters tabs rendered an empty tbody. Fix (derive_masters.py + latin_masters_seed.json auto-loaded by seed_latin_masters on bootstrap) now populates 96 GT cells and 12 return-fee cells; confirmed present in DB, in the API responses, and in the rendered UI.
